[Jan-05-2031 | Turn 0] User: I'm building a balcony hydroponics controller called LeafLoop. First milestone is the nutrient pump scheduler. ->-> 1,1

[Jan-05-2031 | Turn 1] Assistant: For the nutrient pump scheduler, a cron-style interval table with a manual override switch works well.

[Jan-06-2031 | Turn 2] User: I picked an ESP32 microcontroller and decided the firmware will be written in MicroPython for faster iteration.

[Feb-11-2031 | Turn 3] User: The pH sensor calibration drifted badly. I added a two-point calibration routine using buffer solution 4.0 and 7.0 on February 11, 2031.

[Feb-12-2031 | Turn 4] Assistant: Two-point calibration is right. Store the slope and offset in NVS so reboots keep the calibration.

[Mar-02-2031 | Turn 5] User: Big update: I swapped the dosing pump for a peristaltic model and launched the LeafLoop web dashboard on March 2, 2031.

[Mar-03-2031 | Turn 6] Assistant: Peristaltic pumps dose more precisely. For the dashboard, add a chart of electrical conductivity over time.

[Mar-04-2031 | Turn 7] User: Also enabled OTA firmware updates so I can ship fixes without USB access.
A single un-turned memo document for unit u2: the BarnOwl telescope mount uses a NEMA 17 stepper, a TMC2209 driver, and a 3D-printed equatorial wedge tuned for latitude 47 degrees.

[Apr-01-2031 | Turn 0] User: For BarnOwl I wrote the autoguiding loop in Rust and got tracking error under 2 arcseconds on April 1, 2031.

[Apr-02-2031 | Turn 1] Assistant: Under 2 arcseconds is excellent. Consider dithering between exposures to reduce fixed-pattern noise.
